description: This file defines the SearchPage class, a Drupal configuration entity representing a search page, including its properties, plugin management, and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: SearchPage
classes.description: Represents a configurable search page entity in Drupal, managing its properties, plugins, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Returns the search plugin associated with this search page.

methods.name: getPluginCollection
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the plugin collection for this search page.

methods.name: getPluginCollections
methods.description: Returns an array of plugin collections, currently only configuration collection.

methods.name: setPlugin
methods.description: Sets the plugin ID for this search page and adds it to the plugin collection.

methods.name: isIndexable
methods.description: Checks if the search page is indexable based on status and plugin type.

methods.name: isDefaultSearch
methods.description: Determines if this search page is the default search page.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the URL path of the search page.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the search page for ordering.

methods.name: postCreate
methods.description: Handles post-creation logic, setting default weight if not set.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles post-save logic, including route rebuild.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after deletion, clearing default if search is inactive.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Static method to sort search pages by status, weight, and label.

methods.name: searchPageRepository
methods.description: Returns the search page repository service.

methods.name: searchPluginManager
methods.description: Returns the search plugin manager service.
